ReachOut at a Glance · Ministry Overview

Crossroads ReachOut invests outside the church walls  into prisons, neighborhoods, disaster zones, and countries around the world. Since 1996, $71.7M has been invested, feeding over 1.3 million people, supporting 61,000 inmates, mobilizing 96,000+ volunteers, and sending 12,000+ mission trip participants to 14 countries.

    Milestone Years Portfolio evolution

    • 2006: GO Trips history begins  286 participants, all South Africa
    • 2008: New Orleans launches as a major domestic location
    • 2016: Nicaragua becomes a major destination
    • 2017: Portfolio expands  Nepal, Bolivia, Bahamas, Haiti added
    • 2020: COVID low  only 52 participants across 3 trips
    • 20212022: Rebuilding with Alabama, Appalachia, Puerto Rico, Nepal
    • 2024: All-time high  975 participants, 29 trips
    • 2025: 536 participants with Appalachia (141) the largest location
    • 2026: Season in progress  443 participants across 22 trips as of Jul 15 (through Nov 2026)
